title: pvConvertSelection
body:
## pvConvertSelection

Converts a selection (a vtkSelection on the Input port, e.g. from pvIDSelectionSource or pvLocationSelectionSource) into another content type, evaluated against the dataset on DataInput: for example cell indices become the global IDs, or the values of a named array, at those cells. The output is again a vtkSelection with no geometry; feed it to pvExtractSelection or pvAnnotateSelection. vtkConvertSelection can produce INDICES, GLOBALIDs, PEDIGREEIDS or VALUES from another type; FRUSTUM, LOCATIONS and THRESHOLDS are only accepted when the input selection already has that type.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- ParaView 5.13.3 initializes OutputType to LOCATIONS, which cannot be produced from any other selection type; always set OutputType, usually to INDICES, GLOBALIDs or VALUES.
- VALUES output needs at least one name in ArrayNames and THRESHOLDS exactly one; otherwise the native filter reports an error.
- GLOBALIDs and PEDIGREEIDS output read the designated global-ID or pedigree-ID array of the DataInput dataset; datasets without one cannot be converted.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ConvertSelection`. Identity: `filters/ConvertSelection`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DataInput` | Required data input for the native DataInput port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Set the vtkDataObject input used to convert the selection. Accepted data: any data object (vtkDataObject). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataObject"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Set the selection to convert. Accepted data: selections (vtkSelection). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkSelection"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AllowMissingArray` | When true, an array the conversion needs but cannot find on DataInput (the array of a value or threshold input selection, or the pedigree-ID array for PEDIGREEIDS output) no longer makes the filter fail; it returns without error, possibly with an empty or partial selection. When false the native filter reports an error instead. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ArrayNames` | Names of DataInput arrays whose values at the selected elements form the new selection: one or more names for VALUES output, exactly one for THRESHOLDS. The arrays are looked up in the cell data, or in the point data when the input selection is point-based. Ignored for INDICES, GLOBALIDs and PEDIGREEIDS output. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `MatchAnyValues` | When true, each array in ArrayNames becomes its own selection node, so an element is selected when it matches the values of any one array (nodes are combined by union). When false, all arrays are stored in a single node. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `OutputType` | Set the ContentType for the output. | `{"type":"enum","values":["GLOBALIDs","PEDIGREEIDS","VALUES","INDICES","FRUSTUM","LOCATIONS","THRESHOLDS"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"GLOBALIDs"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvConvertSelection",
  "inputs": {
    "DataInput": "UPSTREAM_DataInput",
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
